rationale: The earlier original STOP is 77/163 release-final versus 163/163 capture-final geometry. Post-exposure nominal group QC found only 4/50 matches among positive nominal translocation rows but 45/52 among uncategorized numeric/missing rows; release distance may be signed by geographic movement direction. Test that explanation only as source-provenance QC, not a prospective biological hypothesis.

immutable_previous_evidence.readme_note: README describes UTM distance in meters; it does NOT explicitly document a signed release-final formula.

signed_formulas.for_each_eligible_row: ΔE=Final Easting−Released Easting, ΔN=Final Northing−Released Northing, r=sqrt(ΔE²+ΔN²), direction field=Direction moved

candidates.definition: r when Direction moved=E, -r when W; N/A/other is ineligible for THIS formula only and remains in master denominator
-r when Direction moved=E, r when W; N/A/other is ineligible for THIS formula only

signed_formulas.tolerance: Keep original max(2 meters, 0.05*r); identical denominator for all formulas with geographic direction; per-source reported distance cannot be rescored after selection
signed_formulas.sign_method: If ΔE>0 then +1, if ΔE<0 then -1, if ΔE=0 then 0; no outcome-based tolerance adjustment

metadata_partitions.summary_for_each: source group count, original unsigned release-final match, each signed formula match count/denominator, sign agreement with reported distance by movement direction
metadata_partitions.controls: All 0m rows retained; do not infer movement or homing from sign
metadata_partitions.sign_of_published_distance: Count values negative/zero/positive by original published Translocated distance and Direction moved only as source encoding; no per-row exports

outputs: all 163 original qualifying records retained, regardless of sign/direction
counts and match fractions per frozen formula on all eligible source rows
cross-tabs of signed nominal distance and translocation E/W codes
source fidelity and discrepancy summary at original 95% limit
aggregate-only, suppress residual quantiles below n=5
even near-perfect signed formula is interpretive source-quality evidence, not retrospective permission to score H1
failure_rules: original CSV SHA/bytes/165-row check must pass
exact parent 77/163 and 163/163 geometric baseline must pass
unknown nonmissing direction codes retained as missing_or_other, not removed
nonfinite numeric values STOP except original missing tokens
if signed formula fails to explain all rows, report failure without adding new candidates
no EOG-WF new endpoint, no author claim of published migration effect, original H1 unchanged
test_type: Post-exposure diagnostic on same already inspected published source; no independent biological replication
